exposure: Maternal leukocyte telomere length (LTL) in the immediate postpartum period
outcome: Moderate to late preterm birth (32-<37 weeks)
cohort: A prospective San Francisco primarily Latina birth cohort consisting of 194 participants.
finding: Longer postnatal maternal leukocyte telomere length (LTL) was associated with moderate to late preterm birth, with this association being stronger for mothers under 35 years of age.
gest_age: The outcome of preterm birth was defined as 32 to less than 37 weeks gestational age, compared to term infants (>=37 weeks).
